import csv, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/home/xu/project/loop/DeepScientist/quests/001')
files = {
    'PANEL_ROWS.csv': 'experiments/stage10/05_panel_precommit/PANEL_ROWS.csv',
    'RECOVERY_ENDPOINTS.csv': 'experiments/stage10/06_recovery/RECOVERY_ENDPOINTS.csv',
    'SEED_ROBUSTNESS.csv': 'experiments/stage10/06_recovery/SEED_ROBUSTNESS.csv',
    'TOKEN_WEIGHTED_EVAL.csv': 'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/TOKEN_WEIGHTED_EVAL.csv',
    'SELECTOR_METRICS.csv': 'experiments/stage10/08_meta/SELECTOR_METRICS.csv',
    'COMPONENT_ABLATION.csv': 'experiments/stage10/09_ablation_patching/COMPONENT_ABLATION.csv',
    'CAUSAL_PATCHING_RESULTS.csv': 'experiments/stage10/09_ablation_patching/CAUSAL_PATCHING_RESULTS.csv',
}
counts = {}
headers = {}
for label, rel in files.items():
    path = root / rel
    with path.open(newline='', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        reader = csv.reader(fh)
        header = next(reader, None)
        counts[label] = sum(1 for _ in reader)
        headers[label] = len(header or [])
print(json.dumps({'quest_root': str(root), 'row_counts_excluding_header': counts, 'column_counts': headers}, sort_keys=True))
